note: Rio Grande NF dispersed camping near Rito Hondo Reservoir, ~10,200 ft: from Creede go 25 miles west on CO 149, then 3 miles northwest on Forest Road 513 to the reservoir's parking lot. The FS offers 'dispersed camping away from the shore'; camping, campfires and parking outside posted spots are banned along the east shore from 200 ft below the dam to a quarter mile up FDR 513.4 (Forest Order RG-94-06). Small boats with electric motors only. As of May 2026 the reservoir is refilling and its young brook trout will not be fishable for 3-5 years (FS). Open range (cattle). --Claude

flags: CRITERIA (for a human): no FS page names a campground here. The stored website is the 'Rito Hondo Reservoir Boating Site' page, which says only 'The site offers good parking and dispersed camping away from the shore.' A 1994 forest order (RG-94-06, still in force) bans camping along the east shore between FDR 513.4 and the water, from 200 ft south of the dam to 1/4 mile up FDR 513.4 (a 4-wheel-drive road out of the fisherman parking area). The old note's 'signed Rito Hondo Campground' and 'designated drive-in gravel pads' have no FS source. Under the curation doc's dispersed rule (drive-in dispersed sites may be added when encountered) this may still be a keep, but nothing official confirms designated pads or any RV length.
Phone missing: Divide Ranger District 719-657-3321 (contact on the Rito Hondo forest-order page; FS district office in Del Norte).
Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: the FS points camping 'away from the shore', and the forest order bans camping along the east shore.

Pin 37.89152,-107.17672 is ~290 m SSE of the FS boating-site point (37.89385,-107.17827, the parking lot overlooking the lake). With no designated sites published, there is nothing to check it against.
